raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fix #42060: with `--load-format runai_streamer` and an `s3://` model, enabling MTP speculative decoding crashes at drafter load:

```
RuntimeError: Cannot find any safetensors model weights with ~/.cache/vllm/assets/model_streamer/<hash>
```

**Root cause:** for object-storage models, `ModelConfig` rewrites `model` to a local config-only cache dir (no safetensors) and keeps the URL in `model_weights`. Draft models that share the target checkpoint (`mtp`, `dspark`) are built from `target_model_config.model`, so their `model_weights` stays empty and the RunAI loader falls back to the config-only cache dir.

**Fix:** in `DraftModelSpeculatorConfig.configure()` (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/speculator_config.py`), right after the draft `ModelConfig` is constructed, inherit `target_model_config.model_weights` whenever the draft shares the target checkpoint path. MTP and DSpark both go through this method.

### Relation to #42079 (merged 2026-08-21, which closed #42060)

#42079 seeds the draft model source with `target_model_config.model_weights or target.model`; since #63205 that seed lives in `MTPSpeculatorConfig.default_model()`, which `SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__` only calls when `speculative_config.model is None`. In the real `runai_streamer` path, `speculative_config.model` already arrives populated with the local config-only cache dir, so the seed never runs and the drafter still fails with the error above — E2E analysis and a standalone repro at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42079#issuecomment-4785438700. The two fixes are therefore complementary, not duplicates:

| path | `model is None` (e.g. plain `LLM(speculative_config={"method": "mtp", ...})` with no `model`) | `model = <local streamer cache dir>` (production runai path) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| seed in `MTPSpeculatorConfig.default_model()` (#42079) | ✅ sets draft source to the S3 URL | ❌ not called |
| draft-config inheritance (this PR) | ✅ | ✅ |

`test_mtp_draft_inherits_weights_when_model_is_prefilled_cache_dir` pins the second column and asserts the #42079 seed did not run.

**Note for #61715 reviewers:** that PR's `_inherit_dspark_weights_uri` implements the same checkpoint-sharing inheritance at the loader layer for DSpark. If this PR lands first, 61715 can drop its copy; this config-level version also covers MTP.

### Rebase note (2026-11-02)

#63205 moved draft `ModelConfig` construction out of `vllm/config/speculative.py` into the speculator config classes, which deleted the block this fix used to live in. Rebased onto current `main`: `speculative.py` is now untouched, the inheritance moved to `DraftModelSpeculatorConfig.configure()` unchanged (with the trimmed comment from review), and the two regression tests adopt the same patch target (`vllm.config.ModelConfig`) and mock fields that #63205 gave #42079's test.

## Test Plan

- `pytest tests/test_config.py -k "mtp_draft" -v` — three sibling regression tests next to each other:
  - `test_mtp_draft_uses_model_weights_not_local_cache` (#42079's, `model=None` path)
  - `test_mtp_draft_inherits_model_weights_from_object_storage` (this PR, fails without the fix)
  - `test_mtp_draft_inherits_weights_when_model_is_prefilled_cache_dir` (this PR, the production path #42079 cannot fix)
- Negative control: revert only the `speculator_config.py` change and rerun.
- E2E: vLLM 0.23.0, `Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8` from S3 via runai_streamer, `{"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}`, 1× L40S, TP=1 — bare `vllm.LLM(...)` and Ray Serve (engine on a worker node).

## Test Result

- Unit tests on `main` @ `628c455e9` + this commit: **3 passed**.
- Negative control (only the `speculator_config.py` change reverted): #42079's test still passes; both tests from this PR fail with `assert '' == 's3://...'`. In the prefilled-cache-dir test, `ModelConfig` is called with the cache dir (the #42079 seed did not run) before that assertion fails, so the production-path bug is still live on `main` without this fix.
- E2E (pre-refactor, vLLM 0.23.0): stock fails with the `RuntimeError` above at "Loading drafter model..."; with this fix the drafter streams from S3, greedy output is correct, spec decode is active (20 drafts / 40 draft tokens / 27 accepted ≈ 68% acceptance), and the Serve replica is RUNNING/HEALTHY.

---

<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [x] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [x] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
</details>

+@patch("vllm.config.ModelConfig")
+def test_mtp_draft_inherits_model_weights_from_object_storage(
+    mock_model_config_cls,
+):
+    """Regression test for https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/42060.
+
+    When the target model is resolved from object storage (e.g.
+    --load-format runai_streamer with an s3:// model),
+    target_model_config.model points at a local config-only cache dir
+    (it never contains safetensors) while target_model_config.model_weights
+    keeps the original object-storage URL. A draft that shares the target
+    checkpoint (e.g. MTP) must inherit that weight source, otherwise
+    drafter weight loading falls back to the config-only cache dir and
+    fails with "Cannot find any safetensors model weights".
+    """
+    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+    s3_url = "s3://my-bucket/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8/"
+    local_cache = "/root/.cache/vllm/assets/model_streamer/abcd1234"
+
+    mock_draft = MagicMock()
+    mock_draft.model = local_cache
+    mock_draft.model_weights = ""  # not resolved from object storage itself
+    mock_draft.hf_config.model_type = "deepseek_mtp"
+    mock_draft.hf_config.n_predict = None
+    mock_draft.hf_config.num_nextn_predict_layers = 1
+    mock_draft.hf_config.max_position_embeddings = 4096
+    mock_draft.speculator_config_class = None
+    mock_draft.max_model_len = 4096
+    mock_model_config_cls.return_value = mock_draft
+
+    target_config = MagicMock()
+    target_config.model = local_cache
+    target_config.model_weights = s3_url
+    target_config.hf_text_config.model_type = "deepseek_v3"
+    target_config.quantization = None
+    target_config.max_model_len = 4096
+    target_config.using_transformers_backend.return_value = False
+
+    SpeculativeConfig(
+        method="mtp",
+        num_speculative_tokens=1,
+        target_model_config=target_config,
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+    )
+
+    # The draft model config must load weights from the same object-storage
+    # source as the target, not from the local config-only cache dir.
+    assert mock_draft.model_weights == s3_url
+
+
+@patch("vllm.config.ModelConfig")
+def test_mtp_draft_inherits_weights_when_model_is_prefilled_cache_dir(
+    mock_model_config_cls,
+):
+    """Regression test for the production path of #42060, which the
+    ``model_weights or model`` seed for a None draft model cannot fix:
+    with runai_streamer, speculative_config.model arrives already
+    populated with the local config-only cache dir before
+    SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__ runs (see the E2E analysis at
+    https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/42079#issuecomment-4785438700),
+    so the draft config is built from the cache dir and must still inherit
+    the target's model_weights URL afterwards.
+    """
+    from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+    s3_url = "s3://my-bucket/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8/"
+    local_cache = "/root/.cache/vllm/assets/model_streamer/abcd1234"
+
+    mock_draft = MagicMock()
+    mock_draft.model = local_cache
+    mock_draft.model_weights = ""  # not resolved from object storage itself
+    mock_draft.hf_config.model_type = "deepseek_mtp"
+    mock_draft.hf_config.n_predict = None
+    mock_draft.hf_config.num_nextn_predict_layers = 1
+    mock_draft.hf_config.max_position_embeddings = 4096
+    mock_draft.speculator_config_class = None
+    mock_draft.max_model_len = 4096
+    mock_model_config_cls.return_value = mock_draft
+
+    target_config = MagicMock()
+    target_config.model = local_cache
+    target_config.model_weights = s3_url
+    target_config.hf_text_config.model_type = "deepseek_v3"
+    target_config.quantization = None
+    target_config.max_model_len = 4096
+    target_config.using_transformers_backend.return_value = False
+
+    SpeculativeConfig(
+        method="mtp",
+        model=local_cache,  # pre-populated with the cache dir, not None
+        num_speculative_tokens=1,
+        target_model_config=target_config,
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+    )
+
+    # The seed for a None draft model did not fire: the draft config was
+    # built directly from the local cache dir.
+    actual_model = mock_model_config_cls.call_args.kwargs["model"]
+    assert actual_model == local_cache
+    # The draft model config must still load weights from object storage.
+    assert mock_draft.model_weights == s3_url
+
